purpose.grid_m: Two-metre growing points let broad low grass mats meet instead of isolated meadow tufts.
purpose.patch_metres: Connected vegetation bands with dry interruptions and long views.
purpose.grass_coverage: Living cover in sheltered bands; not a carpet of fire or bare sand.
purpose.sparse_coverage: Open dry ground retains low life between denser bands.
purpose.shrub_share: Occasional branching sage forms break the horizontal grass layer.
purpose.red_brush_share: Tough growth concentrates only beside eligible Red mineral hosts.
purpose.red_host_reach_m: The plant response stays local to native swollen and release hosts.
purpose.min_scale: Smallest ordinary kit instance; avoids uniform cloned outlines.
purpose.max_scale: Largest ordinary kit instance; keeps sightlines low and open.
purpose.max_support_rise_m: Footprints reject cliff edges and substantial holes.
purpose.max_plane_error_m: Growth follows contact planes without spanning eroded voids.
purpose.root_embed_m: Seats root tips slightly into the authoritative native surface.
purpose.wind_bend_per_m: Gentle local wind bends dry living blades with fixed roots.
purpose.cover_distance_m: Near and middle habitat coverage; distant form remains native terrain.
purpose.route_clearance_m: Native approaches remain readable and usable.
purpose.root_jitter_m: Seeded offsets break visible planting rows while each full footprint remains in its own supported chunk.
